kathedraal.name: Cathedral of Our Lady
kathedraal.slogan: Rubens' altarpieces under the tallest spire in the Low Countries.
kathedraal.line: Looked like a hell, with above 10,000 torches burning, and such a noise as if heaven and earth had got together.
kathedraal.by: Richard Clough, eyewitness to the 1566 Iconoclasm

centraal.name: Antwerpen-Centraal
centraal.slogan: A railway cathedral where the trains arrive under a dome.
centraal.line: Newsweek ranked it the fourth greatest train station in the world in 2009; Mashable put it first in 2014.

mas.name: MAS
mas.slogan: Red sandstone and curved glass, with the best free view of the port.
mas.line: Opened in May 2011, the 60-metre museum tower was designed by Neutelings Riedijk Architects.

plantin.name: Plantin-Moretus Museum
plantin.slogan: Ink, lead type and the printers who made Antwerp famous.
plantin.line: It houses the two oldest surviving printing presses in the world, and became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2005.

kmska.name: KMSKA
kmska.slogan: From Van Eyck to Ensor, in a palace of paintings reborn.
kmska.line: The museum reopened on 24 September 2022 after eleven years of renovation, with a new hall for modern art.
